evidence.says: Memory instrument, live: GK.Memory.Field(goblin, eoc::HealthComponent, Hp) gave +0x0 of the component and read 2 = Health.Hp; GK.Memory.Watch on it, then a fair melee hit for 7: the write came from bg3_dx11.exe+0x31C2DAE (inside FUN_1431c2c10, which takes eoc::HealthComponent through ecs::GetComponent; caller esv::StatsSystem::ThrowDamageEvent +0x31C34A5) in the ECS frame of the damage, and Health.Hp then read 0. GK.Memory.Freeze at +0x0 to 5 held Health.Hp at 5 against a write of 7. (research/proof-of-concept/reports/attacks.md, the instruments)
